notes:
New Features:

- The proven direct-child HLS resilience path now applies automatically to compatible Adult-TV-Channels.com live HLS streams, including startup-quality recovery, healthy-session reuse, signed-token warm standby and duplicate-recovery suppression.
- Settings now include a dedicated 2h Check tab with Site/Page selection, 15-minute, 30-minute, 1-hour and 2-hour durations, IPTV Auto Check and separate IPTV/Site start controls.
- MP4 streams are now identified as VOD before their detected resolution, for example VOD 720p, so long-duration checks can distinguish them from normal live streams.

Improvements:

- OXAX long-check Pages preserve the website channel order exactly: Pages 1-4 contain six channels each, Page 5 contains seven channels and Page 6 contains the final ten FAP TV channels.
- Page controls are Site-aware: Adult-TV-Channels.com uses up to 7 Pages, OXAX 6, Adult-TV-Channels.click 8 and FuckFlix up to 9. Multi-Site selections show only the highest Page range actually required.
- m3u4u refresh now validates both the remote M3U and XMLTV sources before reloading IPTV Simple and disables stale M3U/EPG caching.
- The m3u4u refresh can run on the first Site open or the first IPTV channel start of a Kodi session.
- IPTV Auto Check preserves the selected channel as its starting point and then continues through the complete selected queue before wrapping around to channels that appeared earlier in the list.
- The manually started IPTV anchor now receives the same network-based precheck as automatically advanced channels before its long-duration timer begins.

Bugfixes:

- Removes the retired localhost .com relay implementation and keeps only one-way cleanup for files or alarms left by older versions.
- m3u4u update success is no longer inferred from the channel list alone; M3U channels, XMLTV channels and XMLTV programme data are validated independently.
- Prevents Page selections outside the available range of the selected Sites from remaining active in the 2h Check configuration.
